title: Ragdoll Revive
description: An addon for Sable Player Ragdoll that adds a revive mechanic
body:
When player gets a critical amount of dagame, he will be in critical state and can be revived, or his critical state can be extended by items, otherwise he will die

Can be configured via config file.

| Config | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `reviveTime` | Time in ticks to revive a player. |
| `reviveItems` | Items that can revive a player. |
| `extendItems` | Items that extends time to revive. Example: `modid:item:ticks`. |
| `healthAfterRevive` | Health after revive. |
| `excludedDamage` | Damage type that will always kill. |

### WARNING:
This mod supposed to be used in the multiplayer, if you are planing to add this mod into the singleplayer, then dont install this mod, because there are no any singleplayer feature right now (but they are planned)
